name: application-file-drop-preview-list
title: File Drop Preview List
description: A drop zone paired with a per-file preview list showing upload progress, completion, and error states with cancel/retry actions.
useWhen: Users upload multiple files and need per-file feedback — progress, completion, or failure — rather than a single aggregate indicator.
A failed upload needs its own retry action without forcing the user to restart the entire batch.
The list of files being uploaded should already be visible below or beside the drop zone that triggered them.
avoidWhen: Only a single file is ever uploaded at a time with no need for a persistent list — the base file-uploaders component's drop zone alone is enough.
You only need the file rows without a drop zone — use the compact list variant, or compose your own trigger around it.
responsiveBehavior: The list stacks vertically at any width; row content truncates the filename with an ellipsis rather than wrapping, keeping the row height and trailing status/action consistent.
accessibility: The file list is a <ul> with an aria-label describing its purpose, so screen readers announce it as a distinct region separate from the drop zone.
Each progress bar communicates percentage as visible text alongside the fill, not just visually.
Cancel and retry buttons carry specific aria-labels or text naming the affected file, not a generic 'Cancel' or 'Retry', so multiple in-flight files remain distinguishable.

variants.title: With drop zone
variants.description: Dashed drop zone above a file list showing uploading (progress bar + cancel), complete (checkmark), and error (retry) rows
accessibility: The cancel button's aria-label names the specific file being cancelled.

variants.title: With drop zone (Dark)
variants.description: Dashed drop zone above a file list showing uploading (progress bar + cancel), complete (checkmark), and error (retry) rows
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces, including the error row treatment.

variants.title: List only
variants.description: Compact file list without a drop zone, for composing beside your own upload trigger
accessibility: Progress percentage is exposed as visible text, not only the bar's visual width.

variants.title: List only (Dark)
variants.description: Compact file list without a drop zone, for composing beside your own upload trigger
accessibility: Colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
